title: Summit of Winds and Clouds
next_chapter_hook: At the end of the ritual, the Eye of Heaven appeared in the sky once more, but this time there seemed to be a hint of recognition in its gaze—yet was this gaze from the Heavenly Dao a blessing or a deeper scheme?

text.content:
Tianqing Sect, Martial Arena.

Before the first rays of morning light could fully disperse the mist among the mountains, Chen Ji already stood at the center of the arena, surrounded by dozens of gazes—some startled, some disdainful. Yesterday's news of his unprecedented promotion from servant disciple to inner sect had spread throughout the entire sect. A servant ascending to the inner sect in a single step—unheard of. Some whispered in corners, others watched with cold smiles, and some even declared openly—today they would make this ungrateful waste suffer public humiliation.

Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, as if none of those pointing fingers and gossip concerned him. Only the fingers hidden in his sleeve gently rubbed against the warm jade pendant in his chest—the legacy Chen Nian entrusted to him last night. The patterns on the jade pendant were still faintly visible, the clue map to the second fragment of the Tianji Record.

Footsteps came from the direction of the high platform, heavy and dignified, as if trampling on everyone's hearts.

The crowd automatically parted to create a path. Elder Xuanqing, the first elder of the inner sect, wore a dark cyan Taoist robe with white hair tied behind his head, his ancient and simple face radiating authority without need for anger. Behind him followed several inner sect stewards, carrying trays covered with red silk.

However, what truly made Chen Ji's gaze narrow was the elderly figure beside Elder Xuanqing—the old Sect Master Ling Yuan. Clad in a gray robe with a gentle smile, he appeared kind and merciful, but Chen Ji knew what sinister intentions lurked beneath that facade.

"Disciple present."

Chen Ji stepped forward, neither servile nor overbearing. His voice was neither loud nor soft, yet it steadily reached everyone's ears.

Elder Xuanqing's gaze lingered on him for a moment, his brow furrowing almost imperceptibly—as far as his investigation showed, this young man's meridian aptitude was ordinary, his spiritual root mixed and impure, and after ten years of cultivation he remained stuck at Qi Refining Third Stage. A special promotion? Absolute nonsense.

But the Sect Elders Council's decision was not to be questioned, and Ling Yuan had personally approved it against all opposition. He could only suppress his doubts and preside over this ceremony that was destined to become a laughingstock.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, do you know your crime?

text.content:
At these words, the entire arena erupted.

The disciples who had come to watch the show exchanged bewildered glances—weren't they here for a special promotion? How did the old Sect Master open with an accusation?

Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but a cold feeling stirred in his heart. What a clever move—advancing by retreating. First promising benefits to push him to the center of attention, then using accusations to publicly humiliate him. Even if nothing came of it in the end, he would already be targeted by everyone.

Ling Yuan, Ling Yuan, you really don't forget.

"Disciple is foolish and does not know what crime I have committed. May the Sect Master clarify." Chen Ji bowed respectfully, his voice still steady.

dialogue.content: Hmph! Atrash like you at Qi Refining Third Stage—what merit do you have to be specially promoted into the inner sect? Do you know how much this will chilled the hearts of countless talented disciples! Today this old man wants to see exactly what ability you possess, to make the Elders Council break precedent for you!

text.content:
As his words fell, waves of agreement arose from all around.

"Exactly! What right does a floor-sweeper have?"
"Special promotion—absolute nonsense!"
"If this kind of waste can enter the inner sect, wouldn't all our years of hard cultivation become a joke?"

Among the crowd, a young man in brocade pushed forward—Han Chong, the spy Xuanwu Sect had placed in Tianqing Sect. A cold smile hung on his lips, his eyes filled with provocation.

Chen Ji surveyed the crowd, taking in every face—some gloating, some indignant, some simply envious. Some were fanning the flames, some watching the spectacle, some consumed by jealousy—this was human nature.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "Boy, this is the board game. The path you've chosen means walking on the cutting edge of the storm. Now, how will you end this?"

choice.prompt: Faced with the crowd's questioning and provocation, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Keep a low profile, endure with humility
choices.description: Suppress his edge, retreat to advance. Give the opponent no handle while appearing to be hiding his true abilities.
choices.visible_reward: Hide his true strength, avoid drawing attention
choices.risk_hint: Growing audacity may invite more contempt

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his head, his voice steady: "Receiving the厚爱 of the Sect Master and elders, your disciple is truly uneasy. This disciple knows his aptitude is mediocre, and today having received this opportunity, will certainly cultivate diligently to live up to the sect's expectations."

The speech was modest and appropriate, but it made Ling Yuan's eyes narrow slightly. This boy actually didn't take the bait?

Han Chong pressed on relentlessly, sneering: "Cultivate diligently? Ten years stuck at Qi Refining Third Stage—you'll probably never break through to Foundation Building in this lifetime! What right does thistrash have to speak of diligence?"

Laughter erupted around him. Mo Xiansheng sighed: "A pity. Always retreating only makes people think you're easy to bully. But this is your choice."

choices.description: Since you're already at the center of attention, might as well let everyone see your strength and spirit.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal part of your strength, attract more attention
choices.risk_hint: May expose your trump card, bring bigger trouble

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his gaze calmly sweeping across everyone present before finally landing on Han Chong.

"Brother Han speaks well." He smiled faintly. "Ten years at Qi Refining Third Stage—surely it has worried Brother. I only wonder how many years Brother has been in the sect, and what realm he currently occupies?"

dialogue.content:
Han Chong's expression changed: "I've been here five years, now at Foundation Building Initial Stage—"

"Five years to Foundation Building." Chen Ji cut him off, his tone indifferent. "But I've been in Tianqing Sect for a full ten years—the first five as a servant, the last five copying scriptures in the library. The seniors say my aptitude is poor, but they don't know I never even had time for proper cultivation."

text.content:
These words silenced the entire arena.

Indeed, who would care about a servant disciple? In ten years, some cultivated, some enjoyed themselves, while Chen Ji had been doing the most menial tasks all along. How could such a person be compared with other disciples?

Ling Yuan's face grew gloomy. He had wanted to humiliate Chen Ji with this affair, never expecting it would instead give him a chance to explain himself.

Han Chong was choked speechless, his face flushing red. He never expected this always-silenttrash to be so articulate today.

However, just at this moment, a fierce aura burst forth from the crowd.

"Enough!"

A middle-aged man pushed forward—it was Inner Sect Steward Zhou Yan. He coldly stared at Chen Ji: "Your verbal skills are impressive, but what right does a servant have to receive special promotion? If you can't explain yourself clearly today, don't even think about leaving this Martial Arena!"

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan spoke at the right moment, his tone "gentle": "Chen Ji, this old man knows you feel wronged. But rules are rules—if you truly have ability, why not demonstrate it publicly, so everyone can be convinced?"

His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. Seemingly offering a way out, but actually forcing him into a corner.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, tinged with gravity: "Boy, that old fox Ling Yuan is probing your cards. He wants to see what backing you truly have, to decide his next move."

Chen Ji coldly smiled in his heart. Probing? Then let you probe to your heart's content.

He stepped forward, facing Elder Xuanqing and everyone present: "This disciple is willing to accept any trial."

choice.prompt: Elder Xuanqing proposes a trial method—how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Follow the normal procedures, accept the basic assessment for inner sect disciples, steady and methodical.
choices.visible_reward: Perfectly justified, no one can object
choices.risk_hint: Someone may secretly tamper with the trial process

text.content:
Elder Xuanqing nodded: "Since that's the case, we'll test your spiritual foundation."

He waved his hand, and a spiritual stone monument materialized at the arena's center. According to protocol, one only needed spiritual power reaching Qi Refining Seventh Stage or above to pass the inner sect assessment.

Chen Ji walked forward, pressing his palm against the monument. After a moment, eight light patterns illuminated on the stone.

"Qi Refining Eighth Stage!" someone exclaimed.

The eight light patterns glistened in the sunlight, forcefully slapping the faces of those who had just mocked him. Those disciples who had been sneering moments ago now stood dumbfounded.

choices.description: Since you're proving yourself, prove it thoroughly. Directly challenge inner sect disciples, or even higher.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may expose more
choices.visible_reward: Become famous in one battle, completely silence all gossip
choices.risk_hint: If defeated, will face utter ruin

dialogue.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, saying calmly: "Conventional assessment is rather dull. This disciple wishes to challenge above his level—I wonder which brother would be willing to give me guidance?"

text.content:
At these words, the entire arena erupted.

Cross-level challenge? A servant disciple challenging the inner sect? Crazy! Absolutely crazy!

Han Chong was the first to leap out: "Good! Let me experience Brother Chen's superb skills!" He had long wanted an opportunity to teach this ungratefultrash a lesson.

Elder Xuanqing's brow furrowed slightly, but he didn't stop it. This was Chen Ji's own choice—no one to blame but himself.

The atmosphere in the Martial Arena suddenly tensed.

Han Chong crossed his arms over his chest, his face full of contempt: "trash, I'll let you strike first, so others can't say I bully newcomers."

Chen Ji quietly watched him, the corner of his lips slightly curving upward. That smile, in Han Chong's eyes, was especially irritating. A sure-losertrash—why was he smiling?

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying a playful tone: "Foundation Building Initial Stage versus Qi Refining Third Stage—on the surface it's a slaughter. But if you use the Tianji Record's foresight, you only need three breaths to find his weakness. The question is—how many people do you want to see your trump card?"

Chen Ji did not use the Tianji Record.

Dealing with a mere Foundation Building Initial Stage didn't warrant using that trump card. He was simply waiting—for a better moment, one where Ling Yuan would witness it firsthand yet be unable to intervene.

Seeing Chen Ji remain motionless, Han Chong assumed he was frozen in fear. With a vicious grin, Han Chong charged forward. Foundation Building aura erupted in full force, carrying fierce palm wind that aimed straight for Chen Ji's face.

"Die,trash!"

choice.prompt: Han Chong goes all out—how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Win with the smallest cost, appearing to barely win, but everything actually under control.
choices.visible_reward: Hide true strength, avoid drawing attention
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may see through the ruse

text.content:
Just as the palm wind was about to touch his face, Chen Ji's body swayed, dodging sideways at an unbelievable angle. Seemingly hair-raisingly dangerous, yet actually precise to the inch.

As his sleeve fluttered, one palm struck Han Chong's back. The force was not heavy, but just right to push the opponent several zhang away.

dialogue.content: "Too kind." Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression calm.

text.content:
Han Chong stumbled a few steps and steadied himself, his face ashen. He wanted to claim he was ambushed, that this kid used tricks—but with everyone's eyes watching, he had indeed lost—though only by being lightly pushed out of the arena.

What was this? When did thistrash acquire such movement technique?

choices.description: Since you're fighting, make it beautiful. Completely crush Han Chong, let everyone see clearly who thetrash truly is.
choices.visible_reward: Become famous in one battle, reputation skyrockets
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan will certainly become more wary

text.content:
Chen Ji held back no longer.

With a raise of his hand, spiritual energy moved as smoothly as if it were his own arm—seemingly casual, that single palm actually contained exquisitely precise spiritual power circulation. Han Chong's attack was instantly neutralized, his entire body immobilized by an invisible force.

"Foundation Building Initial Stage?" Chen Ji walked forward slowly, his voice flat. "Nothing more than that."

As the words fell, Chen Ji's palm struck Han Chong's chest.

With a dull thud, Han Chong's entire body flew backward like a severed kite, crashing heavily against a stone pillar over ten zhang away, blood spurting from his mouth.

Complete silence fell over the arena.

A堂堂 Foundation Building Initial Stage expert, actually one-palmed by a Qi Refining servant disciple?

Elder Xuanqing finally spoke: "Victory and defeat are decided—Chen Ji wins."

His voice carried an undeniable shock. That earlier palm seemed simple but actually contained extremely exquisite spiritual energy control. This young man was far from as simple as he appeared.

Ling Yuan's gaze was deep as an abyss, his emotions unreadable. He only said flatly: "Since that's the case, the promotion ceremony continues."

Chen Ji clasped his fists: "Many thanks to the Sect Master and elders."

dialogue.content:
Ling Yuan turned to leave, and as he passed by Chen Ji, he murmured: "Impressive skill. But do you think this will blind this old man?"

His voice reached only Chen Ji's ears, carrying bone-deep chill: "You have secrets, old man will dig them out eventually."

text.content:
Chen Ji's expression unchanged, he murmured back: "This disciple awaits the Sect Master's visit."

Ling Yuan snorted coldly, sleeve sweeping as he departed.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea: "You boy have quite the nerve, squaring off against the old fox to his face."

Chen Ji secretly thought: What else could I do? Retreat one step and he'd only step harder on my face. Since we're playing this game, it starts from this moment.

The promotion ceremony entered its final phase.

Elder Xuanqing personally handed an inner sect token to Chen Ji—the token warm as jade, engraved with the four characters "Tianqing Inner Sect." From this moment, Chen Ji officially became an inner sect disciple, ending his full ten years as a servant.

The servant disciples around cast envious gazes, while those inner sect disciples who had just been mocking him now stood in fearful silence, afraid to incur the hatred of this man who concealed his true power.

Just as Elder Xuanqing announced the ceremony's end, the sky suddenly darkened.

Everyone looked up to see layers of dark clouds had gathered where clear skies had been moments ago, and within those clouds, a enormous eye slowly opened—the Eye of Heaven.

That eye was as cold and detached as ever, looking down upon all living beings. But today, when its gaze fell upon Chen Ji, it paused for an instant.

Chen Ji felt a strange warmth emanating from that eye, deep and profound, as if examining, evaluating, and... approving?

Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned grave: "It has come. And..."

He didn't finish, but Chen Ji had already sensed the unusual.

The light of the Heaven's Eye was brighter than ever before, and in that gaze seemed to exist something truly indescribable. Was it commendation? Expectation? Or a deeper scheme?

Chen Ji didn't know. But one thing he was certain of—from today forward, he was no longer an ignored servanttrash, but an official inner sect disciple of Tianqing Sect, standing at the true center of the storm.

The crowd gradually dispersed, and the Martial Arena returned to tranquility.

Chen Ji held the warm token, standing in place. He could feel the jade pendant against his chest resonating with the token in his palm, as if telling him something. His father's legacy, the clue to the second fragment of the Tianji Record...

Everything was just beginning.

Ling Yuan's departing gaze, the Heaven's Eye's attention, and those undercurrents not yet surfaced—all reminded him that this chess game was far more dangerous and far more magnificent than he had imagined.
